title: Quick Emulsion PCR Extraction Protocol
author: Vijay K Chaudhary
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcjpiumn
materials: Vigourously vortex the tube for 1 min.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Mixture for Purification
steps.instruction: Transfer the emulsion PCR mixture and overlaid mineral oil to a fresh 1.5 ml microfuge tube and add QIA PB purification buffer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the entire emulsion PCR mixture (100 µl + overlaid mineral oil) to a fresh 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Add 500 µl of QIA PB purification buffer (5 x volume) directly to the tube (adjust volume for larger ePCR mixtures).

steps.title: Load and Bind DNA
steps.instruction: Load the suspension onto a QIAquick column and centrifuge to bind the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Load the entire suspension on the QIAquick column.
Centrifuge at 13,000g for 1 min at room temperature (25°C).
Repeat the loading and centrifugation if the suspension volume is more than 700 µl.

steps.title: Wash Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column using QIA PE buffer to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µl of QIA PE buffer to the column.
Centrifuge at 13,000g for 1 min at room temperature (25°C).

steps.title: Remove Excess Ethanol
steps.instruction: Dry the column by centrifuging to remove residual ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000g for 2 min at room temperature (25°C).
Transfer the column to a fresh microfuge tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA using QIA EB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µl of QIA EB buffer to the column.
Incubate at room temperature (25°C) for 5 mins.
Centrifuge at 13,000g for 1 min at room temperature (25°C).
